content:
Cloudflare CDN Pricing 2026: Cost-per-GB Breakdown & Decision Matrix

A Pro-plan site pushing 10 TB/month through Cloudflare pays an effective $0.002 per GB for cached delivery. That same site, once it adds Argo Smart Routing, Workers at moderate request volume, and Logpush to an R2 bucket, can land above $0.01 per GB — a 5× increase that never appears on the pricing page. Understanding Cloudflare CDN pricing in 2026 requires you to model the full request path, not just the plan tier. This article gives you the current plan rates, a catalog of every metered add-on that inflates your real cost, an effective-cost formula you can run against your own invoices, and a workload-profile decision matrix that maps your traffic shape to the cheapest CDN option available as of Q2 2026.

Cloudflare CDN Pricing: 2026 Plan Tiers

Cloudflare still ships four tiers as of April 2026. The flat-rate plans bundle proxied HTTP(S) delivery with no published bandwidth cap, which is the core value proposition. The plans themselves have not changed price since their last adjustment, but the ecosystem of metered products around them has grown considerably.

Plan Monthly Cost Bandwidth Cap Key Inclusions
Free $0 No published cap Shared TLS, basic caching, limited page rules
Pro $20 No published cap WAF managed rulesets, image optimization (Polish), mobile redirect
Business $200 No published cap Custom TLS certificates, advanced WAF, SLA guarantee
Enterprise Custom (typically $5,000+/mo) Negotiated Named solutions engineer, 100% SLA, network priority, custom cache configs

Enterprise pricing in 2026 starts around $5,000/month for most organizations, though contracts with committed bandwidth or bundled Zero Trust seats can push initial terms higher. Cloudflare does not publish enterprise rates, and discounts are volume-negotiated.

Does Cloudflare Charge per GB for CDN Delivery?

For standard proxied website traffic — HTML, CSS, JS, images served from cache — Cloudflare does not meter bandwidth on any plan, including Free. There is no published per-GB egress fee for cache-hit delivery, and no origin-pull transfer charge in the way that AWS CloudFront or Google Cloud CDN bill. This is the single largest reason Cloudflare dominates small-to-mid sites: the marginal cost of an additional cached byte is zero at the plan level.

But that framing only holds when your workload stays within pure caching. The moment you step outside of it, metered billing activates, and the "free bandwidth" story changes materially.

Cloudflare's Hidden Metered Costs in 2026

Here is the complete list of Cloudflare products that introduce usage-based charges on top of your plan fee, with approximate Q2 2026 rates:

  • Argo Smart Routing: $0.10 per GB of transfer through Argo-optimized paths. On a 10 TB/month site this adds $1,000/month to your bill.
  • Workers (Paid plan): $5/month base, then $0.30 per million requests beyond the first 10 million. CPU-intensive Workers on the Unbound model also bill per ms of compute.
  • Workers KV: $0.50 per million reads, $5.00 per million writes, $0.50/GB stored per month.
  • R2 Storage: $0.015/GB stored per month, $0.36 per million Class A operations, $0.36 per million Class B operations. No egress fee — but operational costs add up on write-heavy pipelines.
  • Images: $1.00 per 100,000 unique transformations delivered; storage at $5.00 per 100,000 original images stored per month.
  • Stream: $1.00 per 1,000 minutes of video stored, $0.01 per minute of video delivered.
  • Logpush / Logs: Enterprise-only; typically bundled into the enterprise contract but priced per million log lines in some configurations.
  • Cloudflare Spectrum (non-HTTP TCP/UDP proxying): Billed per GB of data transferred, with rates varying by plan tier.

The pattern is clear: Cloudflare's pricing model is a flat-rate core surrounded by metered peripherals. Every peripheral you enable widens the gap between your plan price and your actual invoice.

How to Calculate Your Real Cloudflare CDN Cost per GB

The only reliable metric is the effective cost per GB, computed monthly from your actual invoice:

Effective $/GB = (plan fee + all metered add-on charges) ÷ total GB delivered from Cloudflare edge

Pull total delivered bytes from the Cloudflare Analytics API (zone-level, sum of cached + uncached). Pull your invoice total from the billing dashboard. Divide. Here are three real-world profiles as of 2026:

Workload Profile Monthly Spend Delivered TB Effective $/GB
Docs/marketing site, Pro plan, no add-ons $20 8 TB $0.0025
SaaS app, Business plan + Argo + Workers $850 15 TB $0.055
Media platform, Enterprise + Stream + Logpush $12,000 200 TB $0.058

The cache-only site gets extraordinary value. The moment Argo and compute enter, effective cost per GB rises by an order of magnitude. Track this number monthly. It is the only honest way to compare Cloudflare against volume-priced CDNs.

Cloudflare CDN Pricing vs. Alternatives in 2026

Cloudflare is not the only flat-rate option anymore. AWS CloudFront launched its Security Bundle with included transfer allowances. Fastly still bills per GB but with aggressive committed-use discounts. Volume-priced independents offer transparent throughput rates. Here is how they compare for a 50 TB/month workload:

Provider Pricing Model Approx. Monthly Cost at 50 TB Effective $/GB
Cloudflare Business (cache only) Flat plan $200 $0.004
Cloudflare Business + Argo + Workers Flat + metered $5,400+ $0.105+
AWS CloudFront (on-demand) Per-GB tiered $3,500–$4,000 $0.070–$0.080
Fastly (committed) Per-GB negotiated $2,000–$3,000 $0.040–$0.060
BlazingCDN (100 TB tier) Volume-based $350 $0.0035

For bandwidth-heavy workloads — large file distribution, video delivery, software updates — volume-priced CDNs consistently beat Cloudflare once you factor in the add-ons that real production stacks require. BlazingCDN delivers stability and fault tolerance on par with CloudFront at a fraction of the cost, scaling from $0.004/GB at 25 TB down to $0.002/GB at the petabyte tier. Sony is among its clients, and 100% uptime with elastic scaling under demand spikes makes it a serious contender for enterprises whose workloads don't need Cloudflare's edge compute ecosystem but do need predictable, low-cost throughput.

Workload Decision Matrix: Which CDN Fits Your Traffic Shape

This is the section most Cloudflare pricing analyses skip. The right CDN depends on your traffic profile, not a blanket recommendation. Use this matrix against your own analytics:

Workload Profile Cache Hit Ratio Edge Compute Need Monthly Transfer Best Fit (2026)
Static marketing / docs >95% None <20 TB Cloudflare Pro/Business
SaaS front end + API 60–85% Moderate (auth, routing) 10–100 TB Cloudflare Enterprise or Fastly
Software / game updates >99% None 50–500 TB BlazingCDN or KeyCDN
VOD / live streaming 80–95% Minimal 100 TB–1 PB+ BlazingCDN or multi-CDN with volume pricing
Image-heavy e-commerce 70–90% Image transforms 5–50 TB Cloudflare Business (watch Images cost) or Fastly IO

The critical variable is not just volume but what happens at the edge beyond caching. If the answer is "nothing," a volume-priced CDN will almost always win at scale. If you need programmable edge logic, Cloudflare or Fastly earn their premium — but quantify that premium monthly.

FAQ

Does Cloudflare charge per GB for CDN bandwidth?

No, not for standard proxied website delivery on any plan tier as of 2026. Cached and uncached HTTP(S) responses through Cloudflare's reverse proxy do not carry a per-GB transfer fee. Metered billing applies only to specific add-on products like Argo, Stream, and Spectrum.

How much does Cloudflare CDN cost per GB in practice?

It depends entirely on your add-on usage. A cache-only site on the Pro plan at 10 TB/month sees an effective cost around $0.002/GB. A site running Argo, Workers, and Logpush at the same volume can exceed $0.05/GB. Calculate your own effective rate monthly using total invoice divided by delivered bytes.

Is Cloudflare bandwidth really unlimited on the free plan?

Cloudflare does not publish a bandwidth cap on any self-serve plan, including Free. However, the Terms of Service (Section 2.8) historically restricted serving disproportionate amounts of non-HTML content — primarily large media files — on free and lower-tier plans. In practice, Cloudflare enforces this selectively. If your site serves primarily HTML pages with standard assets, you are unlikely to hit issues.

What is Cloudflare Enterprise CDN pricing in 2026?

Enterprise contracts are custom-negotiated and typically start around $5,000/month. Pricing varies based on committed traffic volume, the number of zones, bundled products (Zero Trust, Bot Management, Advanced Rate Limiting), and contract length. Expect to negotiate; list pricing does not exist for this tier.

When is Cloudflare CDN more expensive than a per-GB provider?

Once your workload requires Argo Smart Routing, high-volume Workers invocations, or Cloudflare Stream, the metered charges can push your effective per-GB cost above what a volume-priced CDN charges outright. The crossover point typically appears when metered add-ons exceed your base plan fee — run the math at that threshold.

Run Your Own Numbers This Week

Pull your last 30 days from the Cloudflare billing API and the Analytics API. Compute two numbers: effective cost per GB delivered, and effective cost per million requests. Compare those against at least one volume-priced CDN quote at your actual traffic volume. If your effective Cloudflare cost per GB exceeds $0.01 and you don't depend on Workers or Argo, you are likely overpaying relative to the market. If it sits below $0.005 and your workload is cache-dominant, Cloudflare remains hard to beat. The data will tell you which camp you fall in — opinions won't.
